mapper.select: SELECT * FROM quality_metric WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT m.* FROM quality_metric m INNER JOIN quality_template_metric tm ON tm.metric_id = m.id WHERE tm.template_id = #{templateId} AND m.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_metric (metric_code, metric_name, metric_type, unit, min_value, max_value, level_desc, importance, remark, status, created_at, created_by, updated_at, updated_by) VALUES (#{metricCode}, #{metricName}, #{metricType}, #{unit}, #{minValue}, #{maxValue}, #{levelDesc}, #{importance}, #{remark}, #{status}, NOW(), #{createdBy}, NOW(), #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_metric SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT metric_code FROM quality_metric ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
